description.value: Your gentle magic eases even the most skittish of souls, a gift that almost guarantees you popularity among parents and farmers alike. If your next action is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets a single creature, you can reduce the target's frightened condition by 1. If the target is an animal, you can also attempt to counteract an effect imposing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fleeing] condition.
